# tfa

> Single-binary Rust CLI 2FA (TOTP / HOTP / Steam Guard) app with OS keyring, age encryption, headless file storage.

`tfa` stores credentials securely, generates RFC 6238 TOTP + RFC 4226 HOTP + Steam Guard tokens, QR rendering/scanning, isolates namespaces, caches master password sessions, encrypts backups, outputs dynamic shell completions across Linux, macOS, Windows.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): User docs, CLI examples, config formats, install guide.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Architecture, tech stack, conventions, quality gates.
- [Man Page](assets/tfa.1): UNIX roff manual page for `tfa`.
- [Full Context (llms-full.txt)](llms-full.txt): Single-file docs + specs for LLMs.

## Core Modules

- [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): CLI entry point, `clap` definitions, arg resolution, command dispatch.
- [src/totp.rs](src/totp.rs): RFC 6238 TOTP, RFC 4226 HOTP, Steam Guard generation, URI parsing, secret validation.
- [src/storage.rs](src/storage.rs): Credential storage across OS `keyring`, `age` encryption, local `0600` file fallback.
- [src/config.rs](src/config.rs): Hierarchical config loader (CLI > Env > TOML/YAML/JSON > defaults).
- [src/auth.rs](src/auth.rs): Master password protection + sliding-window session unlock cache.
- [src/namespace.rs](src/namespace.rs): Multi-tenant namespace management, switching, scoping.
- [src/watch.rs](src/watch.rs): Live terminal TOTP countdown progress bars (`watch` and `watch all`).
- [src/qr.rs](src/qr.rs): Terminal ANSI/Unicode QR rendering, image decoding (`rqrr`), Google Authenticator migration payloads.
- [src/clipboard.rs](src/clipboard.rs): System clipboard (`arboard`), OSC52 sequences, custom clip commands, auto-clear timeouts.
- [src/audit.rs](src/audit.rs): Security scanner for weak secrets, duplicate seeds, legacy SHA-1, file permissions.
- [src/completions.rs](src/completions.rs): Dynamic + static shell completions for Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, Elvish.

## Backup, Migration & Third-Party Importers

- [src/backup.rs](src/backup.rs): Argon2id + AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption + GPG/OpenPGP backup encryption.
- [src/export.rs](src/export.rs): Encrypted + unencrypted account export (JSON, OTPAuth URI list, YAML).
- [src/import.rs](src/import.rs): Multi-format importer (Google Authenticator, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Proton, andOTP, Raivo, Stratum, totp-cli).
- [src/migrate.rs](src/migrate.rs): Direct in-memory migration between `keyring`, `file`, `age` storage backends.
- [src/aegis.rs](src/aegis.rs): Aegis Authenticator JSON/encrypted vault parser + importer.
- [src/ente.rs](src/ente.rs): Ente Auth export parser + importer.
- [src/twofas.rs](src/twofas.rs): 2FAS (`.2fas`) backup parser + importer.

## Build & Automation

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): Rust crate manifest, dependencies, release/CI build profiles.

- [scripts/release.sh](scripts/release.sh): Automated version bump, tag, release script.
- [scripts/release_summary.py](scripts/release_summary.py): Git log release notes generator.
